spans.s: निप नि-प. See under 2. नि-पा, col. 2.

नि-प, अस्, अम्, m. n. a water-jar; (अस्), m. the
Kadamba tree, Nauclea Cadamba (= कदम्ब).

निपा 1. नि-पा, cl. 2. P. -पाति, -पातुम्, &c.,
to guard, protect, defend; observe, watch over: Caus.
-पालयति, -यितुम्, to protect, guard, govern.

निपा 2. नि-पा, cl. 1. and 2. P. -पिबति or
-पिवति, -पातुम्, to drink in, imbibe, suck in; to
absorb, dry up: Caus. P. -पाययति, -यितुम्, to
cause to imbibe or suck in.

नीप नीप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि-अप्, but said to
be fr. rt. 1. नी), situated low, deep; (अस्), m. the
foot of a mountain; N. of a son of Kṛtin; the
tree Nauclea Cadamba (= कदम्ब = धारा-क-
दम्बक = धरा-कदम्ब = धूली-कदम्ब);
the plant Ixora Bandhuca (= बन्धूक); a species
of Aśoka (= नीलाशोक); (अम्), n. the fruit of the
above plants; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a regal family
descended from Nīpa, son of Pāra.
—नीप-राज,
अम्, n. (?), the fruit (?) of the Nīpa.
—नीपातिथि
(˚प-अत्˚), इस्, m., N. of a descendant of Kaṇva and
author of a hymn of the Ṛg-veda (
VIII. 34

निपक्षति नि-पक्षति, इस्, f., Ved. the
second rib.

निपठ नि-पठ, अस्, m. or निपठन, अम्, n.
(fr. rt. पठ् with नि), reading, recitation, studying.

नि-पाठ, अस्, m. = नि-पठ, reading, study of the
sacred books or public perusal of popular poems.
निपाठ नि-पाठ. See नि-पठ, col. 1.

नि-पठित, अस्, आ, अम्, read, recited, studied,
(hence निपठितिन्, Pāṇ.
नि-पठिति, इस्, f. reading, recitation, study.

निपत् नि-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्, to
fly down, fall down, tumble down, settle down, fall,
descend, alight, throw one's self down; to fall upon,
throw one's self upon, assault, assail, fall into, rush
into, rush in, flow in, disembogue into, discharge
into; fall into ruin; to fall into (any state or con-
dition); to fall into (a place), enter, insert one's self,
become fixed in; to befall, happen, take place; to
fall to the share of (with loc.): Caus. -पातयति,
-अपीपतत्, -यितुम्, to cause to fall down, throw
down, fell, cast down, cause to fall on (e. g. to cause
a stick to fall on any one = strike with a stick); to
hurl down; to cast, throw, hurl, throw into; to let in,
inlay, emboss; to direct (the eyes &c.) upon; to spit
on, spit out; to ruin, kill, destroy (with abl.); to
raise or levy a tribute from (with करान् and abl. c.,
in Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 3313); (in grammar) to put
down as a special or irregular form, to give as an
irregularity, consider as anomalous or irregular; (नि-
पात्यते is put down or mentioned as a special rule
or irregular form.)

नि-पतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flying down, falling down,
falling, descending, alighting, prostrating one's self, &c.

नि-पतन, अम्, n. flying down, falling down,
falling, descending; alighting, flying.

नि-पातन, अस्, आ, अम्, throwing down, overthrow-
ing, killing, destroying; (अम्), n. causing to descend
or fall, throwing down, overthrowing; beating,
knocking down; putting on; touching with; killing,
destroying; (in grammar) putting down as an irre-
gularity, accidental mention or use of a word; a form
which by its rare occurrence shows itself to be irre-
gular; irregularity, exception; falling down, hurrying
down, flying down.

नि-पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen down, fallen; de-
scended, alighted.

नि-पातित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to fall or descend;
beaten down; killed; irregular, excepted.

नि-पत्य, ind. having fallen down, having pros-
trated one's self, having descended or alighted.
—नि-
पत्य-रोहिणी, f. falling and ascending (?).
नि-पत्या, f. any slippery ground; a field of battle.

नि-पात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cast down or over-
thrown; to be put down or mentioned as an irregu-
larity.

नि-पात, अस्, m. falling down, falling, descending,
coming down, alighting; falling upon, attacking;
casting, hurling; death, dying; accidental occurrence
or mention; putting down as irregular or exceptional,
irregular form, irregularity (e. g. पूर्व-निपात,
irregular occurrence of a word at the beginning
instead of at the end of a compound; पर-निपात,
irregular placing of a word at the end instead of
beginning); the opposite extremity, the lower end;
(in grammar) a particle, the term for all adverbs in-
cluding conjunctions and interjections, (called निपात
as falling into the sentence in various senses, i. e.
taking their place after other words to modify the
sense in various ways.)
—निपात-त्व, अम्, n. the
state of being a particle.
—निपात-प्रतीकार, अस्,
m. the repelling of assaults.
निपात नि-पात. See above.

नि-पातक, अस्, अम्, m. n. = पातक, a bad deed,
a sin.

नि-पातनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cast down or over-
thrown, caused to fall (e. g. दण्डो निपातनीयस्,
the stick must be caused to fall, punishment must
be inflicted).

नि-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling down, flying down or on,
alighting; striking down, destroying, a destroyer.

नि-पात्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being thrown down,
being precipitated.

निपलाशम् नि-पलाशम्, ind., Ved. (Sāy.)
without speaking, i. e. like a tree without foliage (or
as a leafless tree moves without rustling).

नि-पान or निपानक, अम्, n. drinking, im-
bibing; any reservoir of water, any place or trough
near a well for watering cattle; a well, pool; a
milk-pail.
—निपान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having reser-
voirs or ponds, abounding in pools, &c.

नि-पीत, अस्, आ, अम्, drunk in, drunk up, absorbed,
imbibed, dried up.
नि-पीति, इस्, f. drinking.

नि-पीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being drunk in or
imbibed.

निपाक नि-पाक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पच् with नि),
cooking, maturing, ripening.

निपाद नि-पाद, अस्, m., Ved. low ground,
a valley; (Sāy.) high and low ground.

निपिष् नि-पिष्, cl. 7. P., Ved. -पिनष्टि,
-पेष्टुम्, to crush.

निपीड् नि-पीड्, cl. 10. P. -पीडयति, -यितुम्,
to press close to or against, press together, squeeze;
to embrace; to impress; to cause pain, afflict,
plague, trouble; (in astronomy) to eclipse.

नि-पीडन, अम्, n. squeezing, pressing; hurting,
giving pain; (आ), f. oppression.

नि-पीडयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, pressing, pressing to-
gether; (दन्तान् दन्तैर् निपीडयन्, gnashing
the teeth.)

नि-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, squeezed, pressed, embraced;
pained, hurt.
—निपीडितालक्तक-वत् (˚त-अल्˚), ind.
like pressed lac.

नि-पीड्य, ind. having pressed; having pressed
against or upon; having embraced; having hurt.

निपीय् नि-पीय्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -पीयति, -यि-
तुम्, to revile, abuse, treat with contempt.
निपु निपु, उस्, m., N. of a man.

निपुण नि-पुण, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
पुण् with नि; perhaps fr. rt. पुष् + affix न, through
which dialectically पुण्ण = पुण), clever, adroit,
skilful, skilled in, conversant with (loc. and gen.);
experienced; kind or friendly towards (with loc. or
with प्रति); sharp, acute, fine, delicate; complete,
perfect, accurate; (अम् or एन), ind. skilfully, cleverly,
sharply; completely, perfectly, totally, exactly, care-
fully; in a delicate manner.
—निपुण-तर, अस्, आ,
अम्, more clever, perfect, &c.; (अम्), ind. cleverly;
perfectly.
—निपुण-तस्, ind. cleverly, skilfully;
completely.
—निपुण-ता, f. skilfulness, cleverness,
conversancy, adroitness, versatility; carefulness, accu-
racy.
—निपुण-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, sharp-sighted, clever,
knowing.

निपुणिका, f. ‘the clever one,’ N. of a waiting-
maid in the Vikramorvaśī.

निपुथ् नि-पुथ्, Caus. -पोथयति, -यितुम्,
to dash down.

निपुर् नि-पुर्, ऊर्, f., Ved. (according to
Mahī-dhara) = सूक्ष्म-देह, the subtle body.

निपूत नि-पूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. strained,
filtered, purified.

निप्रहन् नि-प्र-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्-
तुम्, to kill (with gen. of the object).

निप्रियाय निप्रियाय (fr. नि-प्रिय), Nom.
A. निप्रियायते, &c., Ved. to keep in one's pos-
session, not to be willing to give up.

नीप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being low or on the
ground.
